texts.desc:
2+ Level 7 monsters
Your opponent's monsters cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one. If this card is Xyz Summoned, or a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the hand: You can detach any number of materials from this card; place that many cards your opponent controls on the bottom of the Deck in any order. You can only use this effect of "Raise Moon Hope Squeeze - Jackpot" once per turn. Each time your opponent makes a card(s) leave their Deck, except by drawing them (except during the Damage Step): You can attach the top card of their Deck to this card.
texts.name: Raise Moon Hope Squeeze - Jackpot
